rules.clause_label: 4.1–4.2 Duty of Care and private right of action
rules.scope_note: Licensee voluntarily accepts a Duty of Care for Supply Chain Impacted Parties, including individuals and communities impacted by Ethical Standards violations. The stated breach occurs when an Ethical Standards provision is violated by Licensee, its successors or assigns, or an entity or individual in the supply chain before a good or service reaches Licensee. Such breach creates a private right of action under applicable negligence-related law for harmed Supply Chain Impacted Parties; the section excludes acts by individuals outside the scope of their employment.
rules.condition_explanation: The duty and stated breach/remedy depend on the described Ethical Standards violation and supply-chain relationship; the clause does not make Licensee directly responsible for all harms, and expressly notes that direct responsibility is not required for the stated action.
rules.source_excerpt:
4.1. In addition to the above Ethical Standards, Licensee voluntarily accepts a
Duty of Care for Supply Chain Impacted Parties of this License, including
individuals and communities impacted by violations of the Ethical Standards. The
Duty of Care is breached when a provision within the Ethical Standards section
is violated by a Licensee, one of its successors or assigns, or by an individual
